_comment: Copy this to skill-training/tasks/<skill>.json. Author >=3 tasks so the 0.34 holdout leaves a non-empty val split (or set split explicitly). Flip reviewed to true ONLY after you've checked every task contains no secrets/client data — --backend claude refuses to replay a tasks file unless reviewed:true.
_reference_kinds: rule = local checks, no API (recommended) | rubric = optimizer LLM judges against `reference` text | exact = response must match `reference`.
_rule_ops: section_present <heading substring> | contains <substring, case-insensitive> | regex <python regex> | min_chars <n> | max_chars <n> | tool_called <name>. hard=1.0 iff ALL checks pass; soft = fraction passed (the gate reads soft).

tasks.intent: What you want the skill to do for this task (this is the prompt the target sees).
tasks.context_excerpt: Minimal self-contained context the skill needs (paste the input, e.g. a findings.json snippet, a target description). Keep it small and secret-free.
tasks.reference: Optional: for rubric/exact kinds, the gold answer or rubric text.

tasks.intent: A held-out task the validation gate scores candidate edits against.
